metaDescription: Apply online, then follow attendance, term-test results, report cards and fee payments from your phone.

hero.body: Apply online and, once enrolled, follow attendance, term-test results, report cards and fee payments — from any phone, in real time.

why.statementA: A calmer school year for families and staff —
why.statementB: , from the first application to the last report card.

one.title: One record for every student
one.body: Profile, guardians, class history, results and fees live together — no more files, registers and spreadsheets that disagree.

two.title: Parents always informed
two.body: An SMS the moment a child is marked absent, report cards in the portal the day they're released, and fee balances you can pay online.

three.title: Less paperwork for teachers
three.body: Attendance in a minute, marks entered once, ranks and A/B/C/S/W grades calculated automatically for every report card.

features.title: Everything the school runs on,
features.body: From the office to the classroom to the parent's phone — one system, one source of truth.

results.title: Term tests & report cards
results.body: Teachers enter marks, Whizchool ranks the class, the principal approves and releases — printable report cards in one click.

attendance.title: Attendance & SMS alerts
attendance.body: Daily registers per class, with automatic alerts to parents of absent students.

fees.title: Fees & online payment
fees.body: Monthly tuition invoices, discounts, receipts and arrears — pay at school or online with PayHere.

admissions.title: Online admissions
admissions.body: Applications move from interview to enrollment, with documents and history in one place.

portal.title: Parent portal
portal.body: Results, attendance and fees for every child on any phone.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.body: Each person sees exactly what their role allows.

how.title: From application to first day in 4 steps
how.body: No queues, no paper forms. Apply from home and follow every step online — then use the same account to follow your child's progress.

two.title: Interview
two.a: Date shown on your status page

roles.title: The right view for every role
roles.body: Parents, teachers, the office and the principal each get a workspace designed around their day.

parents.title: Parents
parents.body: Results, attendance, notices and online fee payment for all your children.

teachers.title: Teachers
teachers.body: Take attendance, enter marks and write report-card remarks in minutes.

office.title: Office & bursar
office.body: Admissions, student records, invoices, receipts and reminders.

principal.title: Principal
principal.body: Approve results, release report cards and see the whole school at a glance.

security.title: Your children's data, protected
security.body: Built around Sri Lanka's Personal Data Protection Act from day one.

access.title: Role-based access
access.body: Teachers only see their own classes; parents only their own children.

audit.title: Full audit trail
audit.body: Every change to marks, fees and records is logged — who, what and when.

payments.title: Secure payments
payments.body: Card payments run on PayHere and are verified before a receipt is issued.

records.title: Nothing is lost
records.body: Records are archived, never deleted, and backed up every night.

cta.title: Ready to join us?
cta.body: Applications for 2026 and 2027 are open. It takes about ten minutes.

footer.privacy: Student data is handled in line with Sri Lanka's Personal Data Protection Act.
footer.tagline: School management for Sri Lankan schools — admissions, results, fees and a parent portal in one place.
